_comment: Provider credentials/models are set inside the claude-glm launcher subshell. Auto mode uses client-side classifier requests. The installer registers only the private SessionStart PATH hook using detected Python and Git Bash paths; existing custom hooks/plugins are preserved. Main model is explicitly glm-5.3; Zhipu loads the fixed glm-5.3-flash Read-only visual agent at startup. Other provider routes and explicit --model are preserved.
